tools.name: list_local_markets
tools.description: Metro and service slugs PressGEO covers, for use with get_local_market.

tools.name: get_local_market
tools.description: Recorded 90-day AI recommendation data for local firms in a metro, optionally one service. Null citation rate means unmeasured, not zero. Use list_local_markets for valid slugs.

tools.name: get_local_factsheet
tools.description: Published, owner-confirmed factsheet for a local business: services, city, service areas, sourced awards and source URLs. Owner confirmation is not independent certification.

tools.name: get_newsroom
tools.description: Public PressGEO newsroom for a company slug: company-supplied description, links and published releases. Statements are supplied by the company, not independently verified.

tools.name: list_confirmed_entities
tools.description: Published owner-confirmed public records with unsigned reproducible content receipts; not independent certification or proof of AI adoption.

tools.name: get_confirmed_entity
tools.description: Read one published entity and its SHA-256 content-integrity receipt; owner confirmation is not independent verification.
